mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / parses namespaces, mixed content and UTF-16 offsets
outcomes: One root and one self-closing child retain decoded values, namespace identities, UTF-16 offsets, links and self-closing state; element lookup returns the same handles.
gaps: Only this two-element fixture is asserted; declaration, comment and PI source bytes are not independently compared.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / accepts predefined and numeric entities
outcomes: The canonical XML input decodes quote/apostrophe attributes and hexadecimal/decimal/predefined text entities to the exact expected strings.
gaps: One positive input does not test all numeric ranges, malformed references or resource boundaries.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / accepts xml-stylesheet processing instructions before the root element
outcomes: The canonical stylesheet-PI input parses with root qualified name r.
gaps: Only root name is asserted; PI data preservation and stylesheet interpretation are untested.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / normalises literal XML whitespace but preserves character references and original offsets
outcomes: Raw CRLF/CR and literal attribute whitespace normalise while character-reference whitespace remains distinct. Escaped text and attributes round-trip x CR LF TAB y, and the child slice remains <s/>.
gaps: One fixture and one escaping value are checked; complete offset coverage and byte encodings are not established.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / expanded attribute lookup honours aliases, local rebinding and unqualified attributes
outcomes: Seven expanded lookups distinguish root/unqualified, default namespace, alias rebinding, sibling scope and implicit xml:lang. The root a:id namespace is urn:a and its metadata map is frozen with null prototype.
gaps: The metadata assertions use the larger lookup fixture, not the dedicated canonical metadata input; links remain scenario-only.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / keeps the xml prefix bound implicitly
outcomes: The canonical input exposes xml:lang=en with empty root namespace; parsed attribute namespace metadata equals the XML namespace and expanded lookup returns en.
gaps: Checks one implicit xml attribute; explicit rebinding refusals and other xml attributes are outside this declaration.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / stores attributes in null-prototype maps
outcomes: The canonical attribute map has a null prototype, an own __proto__ key with polluted value, and constructor value safe.
gaps: Native constructor lookup does not separately call hasOwnProperty; the acceptance binding checks ownership independently.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / rejects malformed or unsafe XML
outcomes: Fifteen fixed malformed/unsafe input rows throw the corresponding exact XML error code, covering declarations, PI, DTD/entity, duplicate/unspaced attributes, namespaces, mismatched tags, characters and comments.
gaps: One loop declaration is not fifteen canonical cases. Shared prose groups categories without a row-for-row mapping; absent partial output is not independently inspected.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:parseXml / refuses excessive depth, node count and input length
outcomes: Depth 257, root plus 100000 children, and an input over 8Mi UTF-16 units each throw the respective limit code.
gaps: Only over-limit examples are asserted; thresholds and peak memory are not measured, and absent partial output is implicit in throwing.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:escaping helpers / escape text and attribute values
outcomes: Text and attribute escaping match both exact canonical example strings; U+0001 throws XML_INVALID_CHAR.
gaps: The invalid-character check covers text only; this declaration does not check round-trip decoding or every invalid XML character.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:applyEdits / applies sorted disjoint edits with escaped text and XML fragments
outcomes: Unsorted disjoint replacements yield exact <r>1 < 2 <x/></r>; reparsing yields text 1 < 2 and child x.
gaps: Only positive edits are checked in this declaration; the canonical refusal outcomes are asserted separately.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xml.test.ts:applyEdits / refuses overlapping bounds and unsafe resulting XML
outcomes: Overlapping source ranges throw XML_EDIT_OVERLAP and DTD-bearing replacement output throws XML_EDIT_UNSAFE.
gaps: No separate malformed non-DTD output or out-of-bounds edit assertion; this declaration does not cover the canonical positive outcome.

outcomes: The canonical mismatched-tag input throws an OoxmlError instance.
gaps: This check asserts class only, without exact code or message.
